name: Amazon
feed: POST https://www.amazon.jobs/api/jobs/search?is_als=true (JSON body, size<=200, start=N); union of 4-6 student-slice queries (flags OR, student business categories, keyword 'intern'/'apprentice' on the complement)
page_total_how: No site total is printed: Playwright render of https://www.amazon.jobs/en/search (no filters) showed pager '1 2 3 ... 1000' x 10 = the 10,000 search cap, equal to the API's hits/found=10000. True size 22,117 from uncapped facet sums (scheduleTypeId/employeeClass/category all agree). Bookmark page showed '37 OPEN JOBS' = API found 37 for the same body.
robots: ALLOW (no matching rule) for /api/jobs/search, /en/search.json and /en/jobs/<id>; account.amazon.jobs (apply) is Disallow: / -> link only
notes: Every query caps at 10,000 (found/hits and offset+size), but facet counts are exact, so read the student slice: isIntern=1 OR employeeClass Intern/Apprentice (606) + businessCategory studentprograms/university (599, overlap 408) + keyword 'intern'/'apprentice' on the complement (adds 1 intern + 26 apprentices, all US). Do not exclude isConfidential (the new API default hides 209 public jobs incl. 2 internships). Full-site audit: partition by category (37 values, max 3,225), ~130 requests.
